issues.message: Headline 'BUY ETFs COMMISSION FREE!' is clipped at the right canvas edge — only 'BUY ETFs COMMISSION FRE' is visible, with the final letters and exclamation cut off.
CTA pill extends past the right canvas edge; the label 'START INVESTING' is clipped, showing only 'START INVE' clearly with 'STING' partially cut off.
Because both headline and CTA are truncated at the right edge, the intended reading hierarchy (headline → CTA) is broken — viewers cannot complete either message.
Variant reproduces the source's clipping defects rather than refitting text to the 1200x628 canvas; layout intent is preserved but the same overflow problem is carried over.

notes: Variant is essentially identical to the source, including the source's own right-edge clipping of the headline and CTA. Not shippable in current state.
